game.title: Nouka Baich (Boat Racing)
game.description: A spectacular traditional boat race featuring long, narrow canoes (khel naos) paddled by up to 100 rowers. The races are accompanied by traditional songs and attract massive crowds along riverbanks.
howToPlay: Step 1: Teams assemble with their decorated long boats, often painted in vibrant colors.
Step 2: Rowers sit in rows along the length of the boat, each with a paddle.
Step 3: A drummer sits in the center to maintain rowing rhythm with beats.
Step 4: Boats line up at the starting point on a river or large water body.
Step 5: At signal, rowers paddle in perfect synchronization to the drumbeat.
Step 6: Spectators on riverbanks cheer as boats race toward the finish line.
Step 7: Traditional 'sari gan' songs are sung to motivate rowers.
Step 8: Races can cover distances from several hundred meters to kilometers.
Step 9: Winning teams receive trophies and cash prizes.
Step 10: The event is a major social and cultural gathering for riverine communities.
